package handlers

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/readiness"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

const maximumLearningReadinessRequestBytes = 16 << 10

type LearningReadinessHandler struct {
	Resolve readiness.Resolver
}

type learningReadinessPayload struct {
	Schema           string          `json:"schema"`
	ExpectedStateRef json.RawMessage `json:"expected_state_ref"`
}

func (handler LearningReadinessHandler) ResolveStudent(writer http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	writer.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(chi.URLParam(request, "studentID"))
	if !domain.ValidLearningReadinessStudentID(studentID) {
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_student_id")
		return
	}
	var payload learningReadinessPayload
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(writer, request.Body, maximumLearningReadinessRequestBytes))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
		return
	}
	domainRequest := domain.LearningReadinessRequest{Schema: payload.Schema}
	if payload.ExpectedStateRef != nil {
		if string(bytes.TrimSpace(payload.ExpectedStateRef)) == "null" {
			writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
			return
		}
		var expected domain.StudentReadinessStateRef
		expectedDecoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload.ExpectedStateRef))
		expectedDecoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := expectedDecoder.Decode(&expected); err != nil {
			writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
			return
		}
		if err := expectedDecoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
			return
		}
		domainRequest.ExpectedStateRef = &expected
	}
	result, err := handler.Resolve.Handle(request.Context(), readiness.ResolveInput{StudentID: studentID, Request: domainRequest})
	if err != nil {
		writeLearningReadinessDomainError(writer, err)
		return
	}
	writeLearningReadinessJSON(writer, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func writeLearningReadinessDomainError(writer http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrFeatureDisabled):
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "learning_readiness_disabled")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "invalid_request")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusConflict, "student_state_changed")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable):
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusBadGateway, "student_state_unavailable")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrGoalGraphInvalid):
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "published_graph_invalid")
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrGoalGraphUnavailable):
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "published_graph_unavailable")
	default:
		writeLearningReadinessError(writer, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error")
	}
}

func writeLearningReadinessError(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string) {
	writeLearningReadinessJSON(writer, status, map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code}})
}

func writeLearningReadinessJSON(writer http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	writer.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	writer.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(writer).Encode(payload)
}
